scripts.build: npm run build:extensions && npm run build:theme:eve && evershop build
scripts.build:extensions: npm run build:s3_file_storage && npm run build:contact_extension
scripts.build:contact_extension: rm -rf extensions/contact/dist && mkdir -p extensions/contact/dist && cp -R extensions/contact/src/api extensions/contact/src/pages extensions/contact/src/tests extensions/contact/dist/
scripts.build:theme:eve: rm -rf themes/eve/dist && cd themes/eve && npx swc src -d dist --config-file .swcrc --copy-files && mv dist/src/* dist/ && rmdir dist/src
